items: When guest experience improves, customers come back and revenue follows, so guest satisfaction is the metric most worth managing across your locations.
Focus on KPIs linked to revenue: guest satisfaction, repeat visits, incident rate and how satisfaction and operational data translate into sales at each location.
Use AI to analyze reviews and surveys in real time, flag trending issues, benchmark every location and trigger recovery workflows when something goes wrong.
Bring reviews, surveys and operations data into one platform, because restaurants running on disconnected tools respond more slowly and get inconsistent results.
Give field operations teams these insights daily, so they can coach with context and fix problems before guests stop returning.
